# Stack, FieldGrid

The form’s spacing. Stack puts 10px between rows. FieldGrid puts two or three fields side by side; a three-column row stacks when the form itself, not the window, is narrower than 420px.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/stack-fieldgrid)

## Usage

```tsx
<Stack>
  <TextField label="Address" … />
  <FieldGrid columns={3}>
    <TextField label="City" … />
    <SelectField label="State" … />
    <TextField label="ZIP code" … />
  </FieldGrid>
</Stack>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `Stack gap` | `number` | Pixels between children. Default 10. |
| `FieldGrid columns` | `2 \| 3` | Fields per row. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `Layout.module.css`
- `Layout.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
